# SpreadJS 19.2.0

This directory contains browser assets from the following MESCIUS npm packages, fixed at version 19.2.0:

- `@mescius/spread-sheets`
- `@mescius/spread-sheets-resources-zh`
- `@mescius/spread-sheets-charts`
- `@mescius/spread-sheets-shapes`
- `@mescius/spread-sheets-print`
- `@mescius/spread-sheets-io`
- `@mescius/spread-sheets-designer`
- `@mescius/spread-sheets-designer-resources-cn`

SpreadJS and the Designer Ribbon Component are commercial software. These files are included only for prototype evaluation. No production or deployment license key is stored in this project. Review `license/SPREADJS-EULA.pdf` and obtain the required MESCIUS licenses before production deployment.
